title: POV: Bạn nói tiếng Anh với accent Việt trong interview — và mọi thứ trở nên rất thật
script: POV: Bạn trong phỏng interview. Họ hỏi: 'Tell me about yourself.' Và bạn bắt đầu. 'Okay, sooo... my name is... uhh... Minh, and I am very very excited to be here today.' Giọng của bạn lên cao hơn bình thường 3 octave. Bạn biết mình đang nghe rất lạ. Họ cũng biết. Nhưng không ai nói gì. Chỉ có sự im lặng. Và nụ cười professional.

Woman looks at camera with knowing look [Direct address to camera]. Modern corporate office, professional lighting, comedic contrast between formal setting and awkward accent moment, 9:16 portrait.
thumbnail_idea: Vietnamese woman in interview saying awkward English, professional office, knowing look to camera
visual_scene: A modern sleek corporate office with a glass interview room, a young Vietnamese woman sitting across a clean white table from a professional interviewer in a suit. The interviewer asks a question calmly. The woman listens intently, then responds in English with visible effort — her Vietnamese accent coming through noticeably, her voice slightly higher pitched and slower than normal as she carefully pronounces each word: 'Okay, sooo... my name is... uhh... Minh, and I am very very excited to be here today.' The interviewer nods professionally and takes notes on a notepad, the most neutral professional expression on their face. The woman glances at the camera with a knowing look — the universal expression of 'you know exactly what I'm talking about' — before turning back to the interviewer with a determined professional smile. Modern corporate office with clean professional lighting, comedic contrast between the formal setting and her awkward accent moment, portrait 9:16 framing.
